'''Vomba''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he had been caught by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and was being handed over to [[Imperial Corrections]] at [[Mezenti Spaceport]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] when his gang rescued him from custody. [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Heedley]] cornered Vomba along with his gang and attempted to negotiate with the pirates. However, talks ended with an Imperial diplomat being killed, prompting Heedley to ask Imperial-aligned spacers to kill the gang.<ref name="Terminal" />
